related.title: NIST SP 800-34：跨資料集一致復原切點與服務驗收
related.titleEn: NIST SP 800-34: consistent recovery cuts across datasets and service acceptance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付requirements.csv、evidence-types.json、coverage-map.csv與retest-plan.md，清楚區分不適用、未測、失敗及通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver requirements.csv, evidence-types.json, coverage-map.csv and retest-plan.md. Keep not-applicable, untested, failed and passed states distinct so later reviewers can audit the acceptance decision without counting files.
related.difference: 依合成共同提交批次ID尋找兩資料集都可驗證的最新切點，檢查訂單與庫存不變量；再以服務驗收時線確認可用。
related.differenceEn: Find the newest verifiable common commit-batch identifier across two synthetic datasets, check order/inventory invariants, and then confirm usable service through a separate restoration-acceptance timeline.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NIST SP 800-84區分測試、訓練與演練並討論計畫；本課的12項矩陣是原創課程驗收，不是NIST合規認證分數。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 12項需求分知識4、工具4、協作4；已有知識證據4、工具測試2、協作演練1，另3張簽到表未滿足任何缺項。 有適切證據7/12=58.333333%；若把簽到三張當成缺項完成會誤報10/12=83.333333%。

NIST SP 800-34提供應變復原與驗證規劃；此課共同批次模型是原創簡化設計，並不宣稱任意兩份同時間快照自然具交易一致性。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 事故發生100分鐘；訂單可驗證批次時間70、80、95，庫存70、80、90；同一批次ID在兩邊均通過不變量才可用。 共同批次70、80，最新一致切點80，距事故20分鐘；各自最新95與90不能組成同一共同批次。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NIST SP 800-84 distinguishes tests, training and exercises within a program. The twelve-item matrix here is original course acceptance criteria, not a NIST compliance certification score. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve requirements comprise four knowledge, four tool-function and four coordination items. Available evidence satisfies four knowledge, two tool and one coordination requirement; three attendance sheets satisfy none of the missing items. Appropriate evidence covers 7/12=58.333333%. Treating three attendance sheets as completed missing requirements would falsely report 10/12=83.333333%.

NIST SP 800-34 supports contingency recovery and validation planning. The shared-batch model is an original simplification; it does not claim that arbitrary snapshots with matching timestamps are transactionally consistent. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The incident occurs at minute 100. Orders has verified batches at 70,80,95; inventory at 70,80,90. A batch is eligible only if the same commit identity passes invariants in both datasets. Common batches are 70 and 80, so the latest consistent cut is 80, twenty minutes before the incident. Independently choosing 95 and 90 does not produce a common committed batch.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 畫出使用者、排程服務、儲存服務與STS；逐跳列subject、actor、audience、scope及到期，區分代表誰與實際由誰執行操作。
related.differenceEn: Draw user, scheduler, storage service and STS. At each hop list subject, actor, audience, scope and expiry, separating whose authority is represented from which service actually performs the operation.

本地政策要求新token剩餘時間不超過輸入token、服務上限與工作需求三者最小值；scope另取明確允許交集，時間短不會自動修正過寬scope。 輸入token剩餘900秒、服務上限600秒、工作需求420秒；第二情境工作需求保持420，但輸入token只剩240秒。 可委派期限min(900,600,420)=420秒；變更後min(240,600,420)=240秒。到期以共同觀測時刻計算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NIST SP 800-84 distinguishes tests, training and exercises within a program. The twelve-item matrix here is original course acceptance criteria, not a NIST compliance certification score. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve requirements comprise four knowledge, four tool-function and four coordination items. Available evidence satisfies four knowledge, two tool and one coordination requirement; three attendance sheets satisfy none of the missing items. Appropriate evidence covers 7/12=58.333333%. Treating three attendance sheets as completed missing requirements would falsely report 10/12=83.333333%.

The local policy bounds new-token remaining lifetime by the minimum of input lifetime, service cap and task need. Scope is separately intersected with explicit permissions; short lifetime does not repair excessive scope. The input token has 900 seconds remaining, the service cap is 600 and task need is 420. In the changed fixture task need stays 420 while input remaining lifetime falls to 240 seconds. Delegated lifetime is min(900, 600, 420)=420 seconds, falling to 240 when the input lifetime falls. Compute all remaining lifetimes against the same observation instant.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
